notes: Pure gold (99.9%+) bars, coins and jewellery are business-tax exempt incl. import (MOF); karat jewellery is 5%, silver jewellery 5% (general rate, not exempt). Import duty % not cited on a primary page, null. Making per-design, null. Buyback 1.10% = Bank of Taiwan passbook spread 27 Nov 2026 (3,901/3,858 NT$/g). Used 24K: no wear deduction at dealer checked.

sources.name: Ministry of Finance R.O.C. - Business tax on imported goods directions
sources.what: Read 2026-11-28: business tax rate 5% for taxable goods; imported pure gold bars/bricks/foil/coins/ornaments over 99.9% exempt (silver not exempt, so 5%)

sources.name: Charline gold dealer - FAQ
sources.what: Read 2026-11-27: standard product 24K 9999; price = weight x day sell rate plus making charge; 24K buyback with no wear deduction

sources.what: Read 2026-11-28: official board, business hours, 27 Nov 2026: buy NT$3,858 / sell NT$3,901 per gram; spread 43/3,901 = 1.10% (calculated)
